plugins.name: superpowers-enhance
plugins.description: Supplement layer for the superpowers skills — it changes nothing in them and never skips a step of one. A PostToolUse hook injects a matching *-enhance skill right after its base skill is invoked: brainstorming asks its clarifying questions in AskUserQuestion rounds instead of one at a time, and plan execution (executing-plans, subagent-driven-development, using-git-worktrees) is locked to a dedicated branch + worktree, with the git commands that reach back into the main checkout ruled out.
